mapping.cell_state: binary remanent polarization; 1 FeCAP per bit
mapping.logical_to_physical: s=i mod32; physical_row=8 floor(i/32)+floor(j/16); column=8(j mod16)+k
mapping.plate_sequence: hold PL=Vw then hold PL=0; BL=0 for target0 and BL=Vw for target1; VFE is PL-BL
mapping.unselected_rows: WL off; independently selected local row PL and write domain; no shared destructive activation beyond the 128-bit row
mapping.precision: INT8 x INT8 exact signed arithmetic in a 23-bit conservative container, conditional on binary memory functionality
mapping.register_lifetime: capture once per (g,h) before SA reset; hold through eight read-only input-bit computations; overwrite only after eighth bit and before next (g,h)
mapping.reference_capacitor_kind: ordinary local read references; engineering one per SA, not useful resident payload

native_configuration.necessary_encoding: binary two-complement weight bit planes distributed across local row

fixed_drive_resources.evidence: FERAM-03 p2 Fig12 CBL250fF for130nm load model, p1/p2Fig2 2Pr>40uC/cm2; transplanted load is declared engineering condition
fixed_drive_resources.BL_rating_kind: fixed engineering driver provision, not a reported device current
fixed_drive_resources.PL_rating: must support actual switched charge plus dielectric and routing capacitance within stated hold/edge windows; 2Pr lower bound is not a sufficient rating
fixed_drive_resources.scenario_fixed: same driver counts and80uA/BL rating in all profiles; actual demanded edge currents vary; no driver enlargement in short profile
fixed_drive_resources.supply_condition: supply/level shift distribution must support4096 concurrent restoration BLs and32 PL domains; external128BL is a different loading case
fixed_drive_resources.qualification_gap: PL total capacitance and full simultaneous restoration power delivery not reported for this constructed organization; results conditional on sizing/qualification at stated load

drive_loading.excludes: dielectric and routing capacitance; lower bound is not a sufficientPL or supply rating

evidence_and_choices.sense: 8 ns sense demonstrated at 2.5 V in FERAM-03 p1/Fig11; 20/50 ns are longer design windows within its 1-50 ns sweep, not measured complete read periods
evidence_and_choices.polarization: FERAM-03 reports 14 ns write latency, not a proven isolated single polarity pulse. Model deliberately reserves 14/50/100 ns for EACH target-polarity phase in selected two-phase PL implementation. 50 ns is within Fig11 sweep; 100 ns characterization is in Figs10/12. No claim that original 14 ns measurement required two times 14 ns.
evidence_and_choices.dedicated_open_close: 20/40/80 ns total allocation for BL precharge/reference, WL/PL bias establishment, pulse edges, SA reset and return to reusable state excluding polarization holds. Short=10+10 ns open/close (round above 8 ns observed sense); reference=20+20; long=40+40. FERAM-03 Fig9 establishes required stages; FERAM-04 Fig13 tRP=80 ns and complete tRC=185 ns cross-check scale, NOT a disjoint timing block to add. No PVT guarantee or measured per-stage split. Fixed80uA/BL driver rating coversshort62.5uA/BL capacitive edge demand at250fF and2.5V; PL switched-charge lower bound is accounted separately, not treated as a full rating.
evidence_and_choices.voltage: Measured anchor FERAM-03: 11 nm TiN/HZO/TiN, 2.5 V, 1 um2 capacitor tested. Memory voltage domain and compatible access/level-shift circuitry retained as a design requirement; shared 28 nm 0.9 V applies to digital periphery only, with no geometric speed scaling.
evidence_and_choices.write_parallelism: 128 target BL drivers and one selected local plate driver provisioned for a whole128bit row, independently of 128bit input interface; 32 read SA banks support parallel restore from their own latches. Updating externally is serialized by choice to one target-data/decoder domain. 4096 restore BLs demand128mA capacitive edge current atreference20ns, compared with4mA for128 external targetBLs;32 PL domains add polarization/dielectric demand.
evidence_and_choices.endpoint: Open-loop binary write, no analog verify or unspecified retries. Conditional capacity is for cells passing binary-state read/write qualification under stated window; failure beyond budget is failed service, not extra successful payload.

scenario_semantics.paired: short/reference/long pair digital tick and media design windows by choice, not a measured PVT relation or complete uncertainty envelope
scenario_semantics.scheduling_contrast: D_repeat_reference uses the same hardware but rereads for every input bit
scenario_semantics.independent_sensitivity: hold time alone changes; a common hold applies to both restore and external-write phases, so incompatible stream/write endpoints are not crossed
scenario_semantics.maintenance: mandatory destructive writeback belongs to each raw read service; no separate periodic refresh is imposed in the active service window
